summary: B&G Foods filed an 8-K reporting the pricing of a $475M aggregate principal amount of 11.00% senior notes due 2031, issued at 97.67% of par. The notes are sold in a private exemption transaction via a purchase agreement with Barclays Capital Inc. as representative. Net proceeds of ~$456.3M, together with revolver borrowings and cash, will redeem all outstanding 5.25% senior notes due 2027. The offering is expected to close June 10, 2026, subject to customary conditions. The filing is a debt-refinancing event, not a special situation; watch for completion of the redemption.
